author: AI/next_quality_inventory

entries.meaning: ① 未付话费；欠缴的电话费用，手机语境中可用于表达话费欠费。
entries.en: I checked the unpaid phone charges on my account.
entries.zh: 我查了一下账户里尚未付清的话费。

entries.meaning: ① 电话服务暂停；手机语境中指停机状态。这个表达本身不限定停机原因。
entries.en: I contacted the provider about the phone service suspension.
entries.zh: 我就电话服务暂停的问题联系了运营商。

entries.meaning: ① 流量套餐；运营商提供移动数据服务的收费或使用方案，不是设备的存储容量。
entries.en: I chose a data plan that suits how often I use the internet on my phone.
entries.zh: 我根据自己用手机上网的频率选择了流量套餐。

entries.meaning: ① 手机流量用完；当前套餐或额度中可用的移动数据流量已经耗尽。
entries.en: I ran out of mobile data halfway through the journey.
entries.zh: 旅程过半时，我的手机流量用完了。

entries.meaning: ① 开启手机热点；让其他设备通过手机共享网络连接。
entries.en: Can you turn on a mobile hotspot so I can send this email?
entries.zh: 你能开一下手机热点，让我发这封邮件吗？

entries.meaning: ① 信号接收不好；手机、广播等接收到的信号较差，影响通话、声音或画面的清晰度。
entries.en: We had poor reception in the basement, so the call kept breaking up.
entries.zh: 地下室里信号不好，通话总是断断续续的。

entries.meaning: ① 连不上网；设备无法建立可用的互联网连接，不说明一定是哪一种故障。
entries.en: My laptop cannot connect to the internet in this room.
entries.zh: 我的笔记本电脑在这个房间里连不上网。

entries.meaning: ① 无线网络密码；连接受密码保护的 Wi-Fi 网络时使用的密码。
entries.en: The Wi-Fi password is printed on the card beside the router.
entries.zh: 无线网络密码印在路由器旁边的卡片上。

entries.meaning: ① 洗衣凝珠；用可溶性薄膜包住预先量好的洗衣剂的一小包洗衣产品。
entries.en: The shopping list includes a box of laundry pods.
entries.zh: 购物清单上有一盒洗衣凝珠。

entries.meaning: ① 衣领污渍；衣服领口留下的脏印或污斑。
entries.en: The collar stain was still visible after the wash.
entries.zh: 洗过以后，衣领上的污渍仍然看得见。

entries.meaning: ① 静电；物体上积聚的电荷。衣物上的静电可能使布料贴在身体上或互相吸附。
entries.en: There was a crackle of static electricity when I took off my wool sweater.
entries.zh: 我脱下羊毛衫时，静电发出了一阵噼啪声。

entries.meaning: ① 滚筒烘干；把衣物放在滚筒式烘干机中，让衣物翻滚而逐渐变干。
entries.en: Can I tumble-dry these towels?
entries.zh: 这些毛巾可以用滚筒烘干吗？

entries.meaning: ① 甩干；用洗衣机或脱水机的高速旋转除去衣物中的大部分水分，不等于用热风完全烘干。
entries.en: The machine can wash and spin-dry the towels in one cycle.
entries.zh: 这台机器可以在一次洗衣程序中清洗并甩干毛巾。

entries.meaning: ① 时间表冲突；课程等活动安排在相同或重叠的时间，使人无法同时参加。
entries.en: I changed one class because of a timetable clash.
entries.zh: 因为上课时间冲突，我换了一节课。

entries.meaning: ① 迟交作业；超过规定的截止时间才提交作业。
entries.en: I had to submit an assignment late after my laptop stopped working.
entries.zh: 笔记本电脑出故障后，我不得不迟交一份作业。

entries.meaning: ① 按延期后的截止时间提交；获准延期后，按延长的期限交作业或材料。
chineseAliases: 按延期后的截止时间提交
entries.en: I submitted the report by an extended deadline.
entries.zh: 我按延期后的截止时间提交了报告。

entries.meaning: ① 修改意见；对文章、报告等如何改写或完善提出的建议。
entries.en: Her revision suggestions helped me reorganize the report.
entries.zh: 她提出的修改意见帮助我重新组织了报告。

entries.meaning: ① 小组分工；把小组需要完成的任务分配给不同成员。
entries.en: We met after class to divide up group tasks.
entries.zh: 下课后，我们碰面分配了小组任务。

entries.meaning: ① 约定时间；商量并确定见面、通话或做某事的时间。
entries.en: Let's arrange a time to discuss the project.
entries.zh: 我们约个时间讨论这个项目吧。

entries.term: is this a good time to talk
entries.meaning: ① 现在方便说话吗？礼貌地询问对方此刻是否适合交谈或接电话。
entries.en: Is this a good time to talk, or should I call back later?
entries.zh: 现在方便说话吗，还是我晚点再打来？

entries.term: have something urgent to deal with
entries.meaning: ① 有急事要处理；有需要尽快处理的事情，不一定是危及安全的紧急事件。
entries.en: I have something urgent to deal with, so I need to leave now.
entries.zh: 我有急事要处理，所以得现在离开。

entries.meaning: ① 晚到一会儿；比约定时间稍晚到达。
entries.en: I may be a little late because the bus is delayed.
entries.zh: 公交车晚点了，我可能会迟到一会儿。

entries.meaning: ① 先行离开；比其他人先走。这里指离开现场或先出发的日常用法。
entries.en: I'll head off first and meet you at the station.
entries.zh: 我先走一步，到车站跟你们会合。

entries.meaning: ① 到时候再联系；在谈话中已经提到的那个时间再与对方沟通。
entries.en: I'll get in touch then, when the dates are confirmed.
entries.zh: 等日期确定了，我到时候再联系。

entries.meaning: ① 轮流请客吃饭；大家轮换着支付聚餐费用，不是每次聚餐都各付各的。
entries.en: We take turns paying for meals when we meet on Fridays.
entries.zh: 我们每周五聚餐时轮流请客。

notes: Authored from actual fifty-query Chrome input/Enter observations. No semantic approval is claimed by the author.
The broad query 脱水 remains ambiguous. spin-dry deliberately has laundry-specific aliases rather than monopolizing all medical/food drying meanings.
The simultaneous root proposal already covers 衣服串色 via colours run; no competing colour-transfer row was authored.
Remaining financial/payment query gaps are recorded in audit-c.json but are outside this authored subset.
Phones欠费 was not narrowed to overdue bills: prepaid and ordinary unpaid charges are not necessarily an overdue postpaid invoice.
All English examples, Chinese translations and definitions are newly authored. Primary lexical fragments support transparent compound phrases; no online translation/AI provider was called.
